sentences: Since low starts at 4 and high is 5, mid is 4, so low moves up to 5 and ends.
mid equals 4, a[4] is less than x, so low gets mid and later becomes 5.
The calculation gives mid as 4, and because a[4] < x, low is set to that mid value.
With low 4 and high 5, the middle is 4, so setting low to mid makes low 5.
After mid becomes 4, the condition is true, so low = mid pushes low to the high value 5.
